description: Main activity class for an Android application that demonstrates posting and customizing notifications. It provides controls for setting notification properties like title, text, priority, actions, icons, and background options, and manages posting notifications accordingly.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity that manages notification customization and posting in this sample Android app.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI components, and assigns event listeners.

methods.name: updateNotifications
methods.description: Posts or cancels notifications based on user interaction or preset changes.

methods.name: postNotifications
methods.description: Constructs notifications with current settings and posts them using NotificationManagerCompat.
